text:
mira: Heads-up — we need a fast quota push for a dedicated APAC pool we want to spin up next week. Target region: ap-southeast-2. Goal is short-lived burst capacity for H100-backed instances for a limited pilot.

jordan: what exact quotas are we missing? CPU/GPU, ENIs, eips, subnet ip?

mira: list below (rough):
- 60 H100 instances (p5 or H100-class), initially 10 reserved, 50 burstable
- Elastic IPs: want 120 to support one-eip-per-node for debugging/egress testing
- VPC secondary IP quota: +500 (we'll use /20 subnets across three AZs)
- ENI limit bump to 3500 per account to support high warm-pool density
- NAT gateway concurrent flows / throughput limit increase request (we'll need 2x the current)

lee: does this include prefix list / route table rules expansion? AWS sometimes blocks large route tables for many peers.

mira: yes — ask for route table associations up to 200 per VPC and allow our prefix-list size to 250 entries. Also request increased SecurityGroup rule quota to 5000.

sam: cost note — if we go 60 H100s at the pilot scale and run 8h/day, estimate ~ $60k/mo raw infra. Need approvals from finance for the pilot card.

noah: for the quota request text to cloud-support, suggest we include expected timestamps, justification, and rollback plan. Keep it limited to 30 days of elevated quota followed by measurement.

mira: drafting support case now. PTAL before I submit.

mira: DRAFT support case: 
Subject: Temporary quota increases for H100 pilot in ap-southeast-2
Body:
Hello,
We are Redwood Inference (internal account x-12345). We plan a 4-week pilot to validate a dedicated inference pool using H100 instances. Requesting temporary quota increases for the following resources in ap-southeast-2:
- EC2 H100 instance quota: +60
- EIP quota: +120
- VPC IPv4 addresses (per account): +500
- ENI quota: 3500
- Route table associations per VPC: 200
- Security group rules per group: 5000
- NAT gateway throughput: double baseline (please advise required quota type)
Justification: production-like load testing for our Dedicated offering; we will run synthetic workloads for up to 8 hours/day across two weeks and revert to baseline after completion. We will provide post-pilot usage metrics and revert any unused reserved capacity.
Requested timeframe: 2026-04-01 to 2026-05-01.
Please advise any additional approvals or information needed.
Thanks,
Mira (Infra / Capacity)

jordan: looks good. Add a note about tagging and org-account mapping — provider sometimes asks for project tags for EIPs/ENIs.

mira: added tagging line and a minimal cost-account mapping snippet.

mira: Added: 
"Tagging: All resources will include tags: {Project:dedicated-pilot,Owner:infra,CostCenter:pilot-apac-01}"

ops-bot: Reminder — submit quota requests from the primary billing account. Cross-account increases require Cloud Account Owner sign-off.

lee: Who's going to own the follow-up? I can take the cloud-support thread once it's opened.

mira: awesome, lee take it. I'll attach the workload profile and the tokenized measurement plan.

noah: small ask — request increased ephemeral EIP allocation for debug only vs persistent to keep public IP count smaller on long-term. Maybe split request to 80 persistent, 40 ephemeral. That reduces long-term EIP consumption.

mira: updated numbers in the draft accordingly and added a rollback + release plan in the body.

cloud-support: (automated reply) Thanks for the case. We'll triage and come back with questions. Typical lead time 2-5 business days for region-specific GPU instance quota.

jordan: while cloud-support triages, let's prepare the internal approval doc for finance and security: short one-pager with cost, risk, and rollback. I started a doc in drive: /infra/pilots/apac-h100-pilot (please add notes).

sam: pinging finance for an approval thread. If costs come in over projection we should drop to A100s for the first week.

lee: submitting now, assigned to me. I'll paste the case ID once created and keep this thread updated.

lee: CASE-2026-APAC-001 created — added our tagging and pilot expiry. Cloud support asked for vCPU justification per instance type; I pasted our H100 density map and expected vCPU: 96 per H100 node.

mira: thanks lee. Once quota is approved we need an ops playbook: warm-pool bootstrap script, env var to gate API to dedicated pool, and a cost-monitoring alert window to stop if spend exceeds 120% of estimate.

noah: add a health check for network egress throttling — if NAT errors exceed 1% in 15m window, autoscale down or failover to hosted.

lee: noted. will add to runbook. Will update thread when cloud-support responds.
